t: This is the White Tower, the old keep at the heart of the Tower of London. William the Conqueror commissioned it in the early 1080s, after he won the Battle of Hastings in 1066 and set about consolidating his hold on England. It was the castle's strongest point, with rooms for the king and his representatives, and a chapel. Henry III had it whitewashed in 1240. Today the White Tower houses the Royal Armouries collections, within a museum and visitor attraction.
